title: Credential Abuse Audit: Mapping How Easily Fake Professional Credentials Can Be Constructed for Trusted Access Programs

original_idea.body:
# Credential Abuse Audit: Mapping How Easily Fake Professional Credentials Can Be Constructed for Trusted Access Programs

**Problem:** OpenAI Trusted Access requires identity verification, but the security of KYC processes against social engineering and document forgery is unknown.

**Direction:** Document the exact verification steps required for each Trusted Access tier (individual KYC, enterprise, researcher invite-only). Analyze each against known identity fraud attack vectors (synthetic identity, credential stuffing, organizational email compromise). Rate exploitability without attempting actual fraud. Survey 5 identity security professionals on residual risk.

**Why it matters:** GTG-1002 operators used fake credentials. If the verification process has known bypass vectors, the trusted access governance mechanism provides false assurance.

**Relevant context:** OpenAI Trusted Access (Feb 2026); GTG-1002 fake credentials case; Microsoft identity security blog 2026.
